working_definition: Nuclei of the authors' 'Mature neurons' cluster(s) (Calderon et al. 2022), embryos 0-18 h.

best_match.fbbt_definition: A neuron that is born during the embryonic phase of neurogenesis. These have functions in the larva (Lacin and Truman, 2016) and may be remodeled during metamorphosis to function during the adult stage (Veverytsa and Allan, 2013). In the larva, neurons of the same primary lineage have stereotyped cell body positions, with later-born primary neurons positioned further from the neuropil, and they share 1-2 fascicles by which they enter the neuropil (Mark et al., 2021).

justification: The authors' annotation 'Mature neurons'. Neurons born in the embryo are primary neurons.
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00047097 primary neuron (exact match).
